headline: American Express (AXP) Could Be 13% Undervalued On Fresh Earnings Results
summary: American Express (AXP) released its second quarter 2026 results, reporting net income of US$3.11b and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations of US$4.53, compared with US$2.89b and US$4.08 a year earlier. See our latest analysis for American Express.
